sections.heading: Pitch Overview
sections.text: Prepared on 1 March 2026, pitch SYN-SYNCP000023-P1 was put before Cedar Valley Physician Alliance 023 on behalf of PFIZER.

sections.heading: Put Forward in Exchange
sections.text: In exchange the Supplier put forward a Band 1 rebate of 3 per cent.

sections.heading: Sought in Return
sections.text: The Supplier sought a Pneumococcal preferred-position minimum of 70 per cent in return.

sections.heading: Recorded Result
sections.text: Recorded result: the Customer turned the terms down.
